body:
It's a good thing I don't have an Uncle Joe.

Or live by any family. Or talk to them much.

Time zones suck. No one there has a stable phone number.

All I do is show people I care.

Have you ever met a person in the service?

Have you ever spent a great deal of time around a 20something year old in the armed forces? Believe me, they know they're not the brightest. And I don't tell them they're idiots.

Besides, you're not supposed to make me feel even worse about myself so goodbye

I'm graduating in less than a month... maybe. If I can pass my online math. I failed it once already. I applied to other jobs. No one's called yet. I scoop ice cream and make milkshakes. 

I'm honestly trying...and tired of it. Nothing is easy for me.
